question: Which fast food restaurant lie within 160 kilometers along the path to Kindred Hospital - Los Angeles, Los Angeles, CA from Disney California Adventure, Anaheim, CA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-117.919902 33.807062)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-118.378451 33.990131)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'fast_food'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-117.919902 33.807062)',4326)::geography, 160000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-117.919902 33.807062)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
